preamble: No documented direct change of the retroflex stop [ʈ] to the postalveolar affricate [tʃ] was found. The case formerly cited, Middle Chinese 知-series retroflex stops, became the retroflex affricate [tʂ] in Mandarin (知 > zhī [tʂɻ̩] 'know'); varieties with alveolar or postalveolar reflexes reached them through that affricate stage or by merger with other sibilant series. Northern Vietnamese merged retroflex tr into ch, but that outcome is the palatal [c], not [tʃ].

examples.note: The outcome is retroflex [tʂ] (cell t_retroflex_to_ch_retroflex), not postalveolar [tʃ].

sources: Norman, J. (1988). Chinese. Cambridge University Press.
